content: Not limited to the teacher model outputs, some approaches perform knowledge distillation via attention transfer BIBREF29, or via feature maps or intermediate model outputs BIBREF30, BIBREF31, BIBREF32. More relevant to current work, BIBREF33 and BIBREF34 employ variants of these techniques to BERT model compression by reducing the number of transformer layers. However, as explained before, these approaches are not immediately applicable to our setting due to incompatible teacher and student model vocabularies, and do not focus sufficiently on the embedding matrix size BIBREF35.
